annotations.text:
Second attempt. A, B and C were an almanac, a dashboard and a poster — none of them modern, minimal or simple, which is what you asked for. Gone.

These three are all modern and minimal. They differ in temperature, not in genre:
D · Clean — white, one green, plenty of air.   E · Soft — warm, rounded, friendly.   F · Contrast — dark with one lime accent.
